title: AI Age Progression
summary: Free AI age progression: show one character as a child, a teenager, an adult and at 90 with the same face, for film characters across time. Free to try.
body_markdown:
### How do I make an AI age progression of a character?


Make the character once with two or three features that never change, then add that image as a reference and ask for the same person at each new age, naming the age, the fixed features and the signs of age to add.


### Can AI show what I will look like when I am old?


Yes. Add a clear, front-facing photo of yourself as a reference image, then ask for the same person at an age such as 70, keeping your eye colour, face shape and any marks, and adding lines, grey hair and thinner skin.


### Is there a free AI age progression tool?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made the ages here, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### How do I keep the same face at every age?


Use the first image as a reference for every age and repeat the same fixed features in every prompt; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images, so you can add an earlier age as well as the first image.


### Can AI make someone look younger?


Yes. Add the older image as a reference and ask for the same person at a younger age, keeping the eye colour, ears and nose shape, and removing what came with age, such as wrinkles, grey hair or a beard.


### How is age progression used in films?


Films use age progression to show one character across years, in flashbacks, time jumps and life stories, so each age needs the same face, the same look and often the same place to read as one person.


### Can I turn an age progression into a video?


Yes. Generate the still of each age first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one simple action, asking it to keep the face exactly as in the image.
